cards.subject: One zone, once
lines: Dun Morogh and Loch Modan were designed as a single place and then cut in half.
Walk east through the pass and the snow simply stops.

cards.subject: The Frostmane
lines: They ruled these lands before the dwarven armies came.
What is left of an empire: a cave, a hovel and a ridge.
Every troll you kill here is a survivor of a conquest.

cards.subject: There is no gnome starting zone
lines: A gnome opens their eyes in a dwarven hall, in a dwarven valley, and runs the dwarven quests.
The only concession is a gnome mage and warlock trainer standing among the dwarves.
They have nowhere else. Their city is behind them and it is full of radiation.

cards.subject: Eighty percent, in days
lines: Digging woke the troggs, the troggs came up under the city, and the order went out to flood the lower levels with radiation.
The game's own manual puts it at nearly eighty percent of gnomekind dead within days.
It empowered many of the troggs rather than killing them. The survivors are the gnomes standing in Ironforge.

cards.subject: Anvilmar
lines: The hall you are born in is probably named for the last king of the united dwarves.
It has a large forge and no tradeskill trainers at all. The forge is scenery.
In early beta the name was spelled as two words.

cards.subject: Somebody keeps the hole open
lines: The lake is frozen solid and the dwarves keep one hole clear in it for fresh water and for fishing.
It is maintained. Someone goes out and breaks it open again.
There is a wolf pack on the islands in the middle, led by a worg.

cards.subject: The Grizzled Den
lines: It is a cave in the west of the zone and the name is about grizzlies.
What lives in it are wendigos, which breathe frost.
Nothing in the zone corrects the name.

cards.subject: Amberstill Ranch
cards.tag: The only rams in the world
lines: A stable, a riding trainer and a mount vendor, off the Loch Modan road.
This is where the rams are, and only dwarves may buy one. Everybody else has to earn Ironforge's trust first.
She also sells a rabbit in a crate.

cards.subject: Vagash
lines: The herd is being killed by a single wendigo with a name.
It is why a ram ranch in a starting zone needs adventurers at level ten.

cards.subject: Gol'Bolar Quarry
lines: The troggs have overrun the excavation and the mine under it.
The dwarves have not abandoned it. They are still standing there, still calling it a quarry.
Their own mine is full of what came out of the ground.

cards.subject: The airfield
lines: Northeast of Ironforge, in its own valley: two landing strips, hangars, flying machines, gnomes at work.
In vanilla it has no subzone name at all. Stand in it and the location text stays blank.
There is no road and no flight path to it. Getting there means climbing the mountain wall.

cards.subject: Newman's Landing
lines: Behind the mountains on the western coast: one dilapidated human house and a dock. No road leads to it.
There are orc skeletons in piles, and a skull on a signpost with an axe through it.
The weather there is not the weather anywhere else in the zone.

cards.subject: It never stops
cards.tag: One of the few zones with permanent snowfall
lines: A distillery, a ram ranch, an open quarry, a lake with a hole cut in it, and a hall where children are handed axes.
It snows over all of it, without season, the entire time.
Nobody in the zone remarks on it.
